correctness.rationale: The unique maximum split has an ascent into the maximum and a descent out of it when the relevant block is nonempty. Reconstructing the signed series by left-block size gives the displayed recurrences; in the {1,3} series, the length-two left block contributes zero (its signed singleton counts cancel), and the length-three block contributes -z^4 C. With 1-zC=1/C, the series differ only by the z^3 correction, and the Catalan ratios give the factor (n-2)(n-9) on the claimed n>=4 domain. An independent integer descent-mask recursion and direct signed character sum through order nine reproduced no two-coordinate zero at orders 2–8, the four listed two-coordinate zeros at nine, and no singleton zero at nine. This is exhaustive for the stated band and orders, not a classification beyond nine. The frozen checker compares transforms but prints rather than asserts the expected zero lists, contrary to the stronger wording of VERIFICATION.md; the independent reproduction checks the lists directly. The uploaded script was inspected, not executed.
